notes.title: 🎉 1 Year of 5Crowns – Anniversary Update Beta 2.1 🎂
notes.content: [h3][b]Patch Notes – Beta 2.1[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Complete visual overhaul and new dialogue style for a more immersive experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty rebalancing to offer a more accessible experience for casual players while keeping the challenge for veterans.[/p][/*][*][p]New original 5Crowns music, replacing the temporary tracks inspired by Radiant Dawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded lore and light rewrites for deeper immersion and narrative details to discover throughout your battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Arrival of the volunteer team we’ve been collaborating with for 6 months at HoriZon, to strengthen quality and project support.[/p][/*][*][p]Added English and Spanish translations, an important step to open 5Crowns to an international community — finally meeting your expectations (thank you for your patience ♥).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]📅 Available on August 13 on Steam![/p][p]💬 Don’t hesitate to share your feedback on the community hub to help us keep improving the game.[/p]
